title: Publish the registry DID document with a TRQP service entry
description: 'git-vouch-trqp did-document' emits the did:web DID document for the authority/registry with the HTTPS TRQP service entry in the exact format verify-trust discovers (per spike). Document where kernel.org would host it.
acceptance_criteria: verify-trust's own discovery (built from ~/GIT clone) selects the HTTPS endpoint from the generated document.
notes: did-document command prints DID doc with one TRQPRest service, https:// endpoint only (refuse http). did:web: operator publishes at /.well-known/did.json. did:webvh: operator signs log with an existing webvh tool (we add no crypto).
